item.title: Butterfly Bridge Children's Advocacy Center holds fundraiser in Clanton

item.title: Car crashes into Central Elementary School in Tuscaloosa
item.description: TUSCALOOSA, Ala. (WIAT) -- A car crashed into a Tuscaloosa elementary school Wednesday night following a two-vehicle collision, police said.
